basic_details.job_title: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Court of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Nyayalaya Motor Durghatna Dava Adhikaran), Kanpur Dehat, has one post of Assistant Clerk (Sahayak Lipik) to be filled on contract, open only to retired employees aged between 60 and 65 years. Applications go to the Office of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ramabai Nagar (Kanpur Dehat) by registered post, speed post or in person, and must be received by 23 November 2026, 4:00 PM.

age_limit.details: The age of the applicant must be between 60 years and 65 years as on 01.10.2026. Employees retiring on 31 October 2026 are also eligible to apply. The notice prints no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About MACT Kanpur Dehat
content_sections.text: The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ramabai Nagar (Kanpur Dehat) is a tribunal court in Kanpur Dehat district of Uttar Pradesh, headed by a Presiding Officer. The notice is signed by Smt. Shaziya Nazar Zaidi, Presiding Officer. The engagement of retired personnel is made in continuation of Uttar Pradesh Government Order No. 676/30-3-2019, Transport Section-3, dated 09.03.2019.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: Office of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ramabai Nagar (Kanpur Dehat). Mode: registered post, speed post, or submit it in person at the office. The application must reach the office by 23 November 2026, 4:00 PM. Any application received after the last date and time will not be considered. No printed application form is attached to the notice. The application must clearly state the candidate's name, father's name, date of birth, complete address and mobile number, with a self-attested photograph. The notice does not mention any wording to be written on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is 01 post of Assistant Clerk (Sahayak Lipik). The notice gives no category-wise break-up. Retired employees having similar work experience of a Hon'ble Court, Central Government, State Government, Government institution, Government department or Board etc. Knowledge of computer is very essential. Preference will be given to employees retired from the District Court. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, though educational certificates must be enclosed. Check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording. The age of the applicant must be between 60 years and 65 years as on 01.10.2026. Employees retiring on 31 October 2026 are also eligible to apply. The notice prints no age relaxation. Selection is on contract basis from retired personnel, on the condition that the amount paid on contract will be a monthly honorarium equal to the amount left after deducting the net pension (before commutation, if any) from the employee's last drawn pay. The notice does not print a fixed amount. The engagement is on contract, up to the age of 65 years or until full-time personnel are posted (by service, transfer or deputation), whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photograph Educational certificates Character certificate Retirement pension papers The notice lists these documents with "etc.", so other relevant records may also be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per Government Order No. MACT-73/30.03.2019, Transport Section-3, Lucknow, dated 25 February 2020, recruitment to the vacant post will be made by a committee chaired by the Presiding Officer. Candidates will be informed of the interview on their mobile or telephone number. The Chairman of the selection committee has full right to accept or reject any application.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only retired personnel can apply for this post. The notice is displayed on the notice boards of the District Court and the Collectorate, Kanpur Dehat, and sent for upload on the websites of the Hon'ble High Court and NIC Kanpur Dehat. Keep the mobile or telephone number given in the application reachable, as interview information will be sent on it.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MACT Kanpur Dehat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Assistant Clerk (Sahayak Lipik) at the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ramabai Nagar (Kanpur Dehat).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk post?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 23 November 2026, 4:00 PM. Applications received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk post?
faq.answer: Retired employees with similar work experience of a Hon'ble Court, Central Government, State Government, Government institution, Government department or Board etc., with essential computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant's age must be between 60 years and 65 years as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. Can employees retiring on 31 October 2026 apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that employees retiring on 31 October 2026 are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk?
faq.answer: A monthly honorarium equal to the last drawn pay minus the net pension (before commutation, if any) is payable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk post?
faq.answer: Send the application with a self-attested photograph and the required documents by registered post or speed post, or submit it in person, to the Office of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ramabai Nagar (Kanpur Dehat).

faq.question: Q8. How will the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be made by a committee chaired by the Presiding Officer, and candidates will be informed of the interview on their mobile or telephone number.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement up to the age of 65 years or until full-time personnel are posted, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference for the MACT Kanpur Dehat Assistant Clerk post?
faq.answer: Employees retired from the District Court will be given preference.
